mapper.select: SELECT PROD_ID as prodId, PROD_CODE as prodCode, PROD_NAME as name, PROD_PRICE as price, IMAGE_URL as imageUrl, SOURCE as communityName, BOARD_TYPE as boardType, REG_DATE as regDate FROM Common_Product ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.PROD_ID as prodId, p.PROD_NAME as name, p.PROD_PRICE as price, p.IMAGE_URL as imageUrl, p.SOURCE as communityName, p.BOARD_TYPE as boardType, p.REG_DATE as regDate, h.PREV_PRICE as prevPrice, ((h.PREV_PRICE - p.PROD_PRICE) / h.PREV_PRICE * 100) as dropRate FROM Common_Product p JOIN ( SELECT PROD_ID, PRICE as PREV_PRICE FROM ( SELECT PROD_ID, PRICE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PROD_ID ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC) as rn FROM PRICE_HISTORY ) WHERE rn = 2 ) h ON p.PROD_ID = h.PROD_ID ) WHERE dropRate >= 10 OR boardType = 'DROP' ORDER BY regDate DESC

SELECT PROD_ID as prodId, PROD_NAME as name, PROD_PRICE as price, TARGET_PRICE as targetPrice, IMAGE_URL as imageUrl, SOURCE as communityName, REG_DATE as regDate FROM Common_Product WHERE PROD_ID = #{prodId}
SELECT PRICE as price, REG_DATE as regDate FROM PRICE_HISTORY WHERE PROD_ID = #{prodId} ORDER BY REG_DATE ASC
SELECT PROD_NAME as name, PROD_PRICE as price, TARGET_PRICE as targetPrice FROM Common_Product WHERE PROD_ID = #{prodId}
mapper.update: UPDATE Common_Product SET PROD_PRICE = #{price}, TARGET_PRICE = #{targetPrice}, CHECK_INTERVAL = #{checkInterval}, REG_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE PROD_ID = #{prodId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRICE_HISTORY (PROD_ID, PRICE, REG_DATE) VALUES (#{prodId}, #{price}, SYSDATE)

INSERT INTO Common_Product ( PROD_CODE, SOURCE, PROD_NAME, PROD_PRICE, TARGET_PRICE, CHECK_INTERVAL, IMAGE_URL, BOARD_TYPE, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{prodCode}, 'DANAWA', #{name}, #{price}, #{targetPrice}, #{checkInterval}, #{imageUrl}, 'CRAWL', SYSDATE )
mapper.update: MERGE INTO Common_Product p USING DUAL ON (p.PROD_CODE = #{prodCode}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET p.PROD_PRICE = #{price}, p.REG_DATE = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PROD_CODE, SOURCE, PROD_NAME, PROD_PRICE, IMAGE_URL, BOARD_TYPE, REG_DATE) VALUES (#{prodCode}, 'DANAWA', #{name}, #{price}, #{imageUrl}, 'CRAWL', SYSDATE)
